description: Undo the most recent reversible mutation (receipt FIFO). Same inversion semantics as undo_mutation: add/save → remove, removal → re-add. Executing needs confirmation and is refused when the client cannot prompt (SPOTIFY_MCP_CONFIRM=never bypasses).

dry_run.description: Preview only, and the default: pass dry_run: false to execute the rollback.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: undo_last_mutation
